endpoint.description: Method and URL, e.g. POST https://api.example-esp.com/v1/messages

messageIdPath.description: JSONPath of the message id in the response, e.g. $.data.id

manifestUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the adapter's manifest.json

template.description: Starter template; omit for a blank canvas

changes.description: Unpublished changes, as counted by the version diff
Unpublished changes compared with the live version

flows.description: Live automations triggered by this event

percent.description: Contacts who reached the goal, % of those who entered in the window

completed.description: % of entrants who finished the flow (goal or end)

migration.description: finish: contacts in the flow finish on the old version; move: they move to the new one at their current step

version.description: The draft version reviewed in the publish dialog

healthy.description: A provider on the route can send right now

status.description: healthy, degraded, down, sandbox, warming_up or paused

completed.description: Moved on to the next step

dropped.description: Left early: filtered out, unsubscribed or removed

exited.description: Finished the flow at this step

status.description: retiring: replaced, but contacts are still finishing on it

spf.description: aligned, or the raw result: fail, softfail, none…

source.description: One blocklist; every list the asset is on when omitted

dmarc.description: Policy (none, quarantine, reject) or missing / invalid

label.description: Bounce rate, Complaint rate, Spam complaint rate

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

apiKey.description: A HostRepute API key (hr_live_…) with the monitor:read, alerts:read and assets:write scopes. Write-only: it is stored encrypted and never returned.

asset.description: A sending domain, organization domain, dedicated IP or server hostname of this workspace

dmarcAligned.description: Percent of DMARC-aligned mail in the last 7 days

message.description: Couldn't reach api.hostrepute.com (timeout after 30 s, 3 attempts)

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

helpers.description: Members who hold the missing permission

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

errorRate7d.description: Percent of API calls that failed

values.description: Credential keys and their new values. Keys not listed keep their current value.

decision.description: wait, move or cancel once someone decided

targetProviderId.description: Provider to move the held share to (move)

fallback.description: Provider id, or empty for none

startUrl.description: Navigate here to start the OIDC flow

methods.description: Second factors available: totp, passkey, recovery

challenge.description: Pass back with the first code to confirm

secret.description: Base32 secret grouped by four for manual entry

url.description: otpauth:// URL for the QR code

bearer.description: API key (rc_live_…) or MCP agent token (rc_agent_…)

info.description: The ReputeCast HTTP API. Every operation declares the permission it needs (x-permission); users, API keys and MCP agents go through the same check. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.
